channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: What’s Iran’s 14-point proposal to end the war? And will Trump accept it?
item.description: Trump is reviewing Iran's latest proposal to end the war, but the mistrust between the two sides is a big obstacle.

item.title: Strait of Hormuz blockade and other major naval sieges in modern times
item.description: Naval blockades are among the oldest weapons of war, using sea control to cut supplies and force an enemy’s surrender.

item.title: Ukraine drone attack hits Russian Baltic port, governor says
item.description: Ukrainian forces also strike two shadow fleet tankers near port of Novorossiysk, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy says.

item.title: Iran war: What’s happening on day 65 as Trump reviews new plan to end war?
item.description: Iran has sent the US a new 14-point proposal to end the war.

item.title: China blocks US sanctions against five ‘teapot’ refineries
item.description: Ministry of Commerce says sanctions against refineries accused of importing Iranian oil violate international law.

item.title: In Yemen, Starlink internet brings opportunities – for some
item.description: Despite Houthi resistance and affordability challenges, Starlink fuels growth in Yemen's digital workforce.

item.title: Millions of jobs lost as Iranians battle ‘Operation Economic Fury’
item.description: A fragile ceasefire may have paused the US-Israeli war on Iran, but the economic cost is crippling life in Tehran.

item.title: The Iran war has strengthened Ukraine in surprising ways. Could a ceasefire with Russia be closer?
item.description: President Zelensky has been visiting the Gulf to demonstrate his country's military nous.

item.title: The clandestine network smuggling Starlink tech into Iran to beat internet blackout
item.description: Sahand tells the BBC World Service he sends satellite internet terminals into Iran to help show "the real picture".

item.title: Concern for jailed Iranian Nobel laureate as family say health deteriorating
item.description: On Friday her family said the 54-year-old had been taken from prison to a local hospital after a sharp deterioration in her health.
